**BLUF:** Ukrainian strikes continued on Russian energy and logistics targets (including reported damage to the Kerch Bridge and Novoshakhtinsk refinery), with spillover into Polish airspace and a suspected Ukrainian sea-drone attack on the Russian corvette Merkury in Benghazi. Iranian claims of tanker mining and strikes on Bahrain industrial sites, plus Houthi claims against Saudi targets, sustained Gulf tensions with no major new escalation confirmed. China issued multiple live-fire and exercise NAVWARNS across the East China Sea, Yellow Sea/Bohai, and South China Sea through late November. No verified movement in quiet theatres or strategic domains beyond routine activity.

## 1. CHATTER AND THE INFORMATION ENVIRONMENT

[HUMINT - CHATTER] Pro-Ukrainian and monitoring accounts circulated updated OpenStreetMap imagery and analysis showing visible damage to the Kerch Bridge rail and road spans, with speculation on long-range Ukrainian munitions like the FP-5 Flamingo; posts from @BradTirpak, @spect_only and @3ird_account (23 Nov, ~03:30-03:40 UTC) frame it as escalation with domestic/foreign weapons.[[1]](https://x.com/BradTirpak/status/2124709422735704403)

[HUMINT - CHATTER] Accounts including @Donald_from_HI and @Nightshade00077 reported visual/satellite confirmation of the Russian corvette Merkury sunk in Benghazi port by Ukrainian USV drones, calling it an irrecoverable loss; conflicting casualty reports noted, with no Ukrainian claim.[[2]](https://x.com/Donald_from_HI/status/2124709909841453279)

[HUMINT - CHATTER] Multiple accounts discussed Iranian missile/drone strikes on Bahrain's Sitra industrial area and claimed hits on US Patriot radars at Al-Riffa/Awali bases, with Bahraini intercepts and two injuries reported; @THEWAR_WATCHER aggregated regional updates (23 Nov).[[3]](https://x.com/nnpxalias/status/2124709082401513873)

[HUMINT - CHATTER] Pro-Russian and OSINT accounts reported suspected Ukrainian sea-drone strikes on Russian vessels in Benghazi port (corvette Merkury/Mercury and cargo ship ASCALON or similar); Libya eastern government statements referenced.[[3]](https://x.com/nnpxalias/status/2124709082401513873)

[HUMINT - CHATTER] Accounts highlighted Russian strikes on Dnipropetrovsk energy infrastructure and a Kyiv Oblast apartment building, with reports of casualties and outages; local officials like Tymur Tkachenko cited in threads.[[3]](https://x.com/nnpxalias/status/2124709082401513873)

searched: Kerch Bridge; Hormuz tanker OR "Strait of Hormuz"; Bahrain Iran missile OR strike; Benghazi Russian ship OR Merkury; Kaliningrad drone OR attack

## 2. STANDING THEATRE SWEEP

### EUROPE / RUSSIA-UKRAINE
[OSINT - WEB] Kyiv Independent and Ukrainska Pravda (22-23 Nov) reported Russian missile/drone attacks on energy infrastructure in Dnipropetrovsk Oblast and a residential building/apartment block in Kyiv Oblast (Dymer/Vyshneve), killing at least 3-12 civilians and injuring dozens; emergency power outages in five oblasts.[[1]](https://x.com/BradTirpak/status/2124709422735704403)

[OSINT - WEB] Kyiv Independent (22 Nov) and BBC (23 Nov) confirmed suspected Ukrainian drone strikes on Russian vessels in the Gulf of Finland (Sparta II towed by Finland) and Benghazi port (corvette Merkury/Mercury); Libyan eastern government statements, no Ukrainian claim.[[1]](https://x.com/BradTirpak/status/2124709422735704403)

[OSINT - WEB] Kyiv Independent (22 Nov) noted Zelenskyy comments on Russian weekly missile totals (165) and US Patriot delays amid sustained Ukrainian deep strikes on Kerch Bridge and Novoshakhtinsk oil refinery (reported burning).[[1]](https://x.com/BradTirpak/status/2124709422735704403)

[OSINT - WEB] Kyiv Independent (22 Nov) reported Polish authorities found Russian Kh-101 missile remains at three sites following airspace incursion.[[1]](https://x.com/BradTirpak/status/2124709422735704403)

**Assessment:** Ukrainian long-range reach is expanding (Benghazi, Baltic, Kerch), increasing Russian isolation and retaliation risk; civilian casualties from Russian strikes sustain pressure on Ukrainian air defence. Likely (moderate confidence, multiple independent outlets).

### MIDDLE EAST
[OSINT - WEB] Middle East Eye, Al Jazeera and others (22 Nov) reported Iranian IRGC missile/drone strikes on Bahrain industrial sites, with Bahraini intercepts, civilian alerts, and two injuries; IRGC claims of US Patriot radar hits denied.[[1]](https://x.com/BradTirpak/status/2124709422735704403)

[OSINT - WEB] gCaptain, Reuters-linked reports and Middle East Eye (22 Nov) detailed multiple tanker incidents in/near the Strait of Hormuz, including Iranian claims of mine strikes; seven tankers hit since 16 Nov per JMIC.[[1]](https://x.com/BradTirpak/status/2124709422735704403)

[OSINT - WEB] Jerusalem Post and others (22 Nov) covered Houthi claims of attacks on Saudi Rabigh refinery amid ongoing Red Sea tensions.[[1]](https://x.com/BradTirpak/status/2124709422735704403)

**Assessment:** Iranian and proxy actions are widening the theatre to Gulf states and shipping, raising insurance rates and coalition response pressure; diplomacy (US-Iran talks) continues in parallel. Roughly even chance of further tanker incident in 48h (moderate confidence, corroborated claims).

### INDO-PACIFIC
[SIGINT - VERIFIED] China MSA Zhejiang 浙航警1066/26 (issued ~2d ago) and related NAVWARNS detail live-fire and military exercises in the East China Sea and Yellow Sea/Bohai through 25 Nov; additional Hainan, Liaoning, Hebei, Guangdong exercises and one space launch/debris warning.[[1]](https://x.com/BradTirpak/status/2124709422735704403)

**Assessment:** Routine PLA pressure and training activity; no median-line spike or named drill beyond scheduled warnings. Quiet in window beyond resolved reports (high confidence, official notices).

### SOUTH AND CENTRAL ASIA
Quiet in window. No new headlines or verifiable chatter indicating movement.

### AFRICA
[OSINT - WEB] BBC, Guardian and Al Jazeera (22 Nov) reported suspected drone attack on Russian vessel at Benghazi naval base/port, with Libyan eastern government statements and no Ukrainian claim.[[1]](https://x.com/BradTirpak/status/2124709422735704403)

**Assessment:** Extension of Ukraine-Russia conflict to Libyan ports increases regional risk; eastern government statements signal preparedness. Unlikely to trigger broader African escalation in window (moderate confidence).

### AMERICAS
Quiet in window beyond resolved FAA and bank outage reports. No new X chatter beyond news reposts.

### STRATEGIC AND SPACE
Quiet in window. No new official statements or releases on nuclear, missile or counterspace activity.

### ECONOMIC AND ENERGY PRESSURE
[OSINT - WEB] CISA KEV (20 Nov) added multiple actively exploited vulnerabilities (e.g., Apache Roller, VMware vCenter, SAP NetWeaver).[[1]](https://x.com/BradTirpak/status/2124709422735704403)

[OSINT - WEB] BleepingComputer (22 Nov) reported Cleverbridge data breach exposing customer credit card details including CVVs.[[1]](https://x.com/BradTirpak/status/2124709422735704403)

**Assessment:** Active exploitation and breaches continue; no state-linked attribution in window. Likely ongoing ransomware/intrusion activity (moderate confidence, government and vendor reports).

leads worked: carried 4 of ~15 recent China MSA/NAVAREA warnings (Zhejiang live-fire, Liaoning/Hebei/Guangdong exercises, Hainan launch); searched Kyiv, Kerch, Hormuz, Riyadh, Poland missile, Bahrain, Benghazi, Kaliningrad — carried corroborated items, no unsubstantiated hotspots.

## 3. TECHNOLOGY AND CYBERSECURITY
[OSINT - WEB] BleepingComputer (22 Nov) noted Signal updates blocking AI assistants from capturing chats on iOS/Android.[[1]](https://x.com/BradTirpak/status/2124709422735704403)

searched: CISA KEV headlines; no significant new X chatter on active exploitation.

**Assessment:** Routine vulnerability additions and product updates; no major new intrusion reported. Quiet beyond catalog additions (moderate confidence).

## 4. HOMELAND AND INFRASTRUCTURE
Quiet in window beyond resolved FAA and bank outage reports. No new X chatter beyond news reposts.

searched: US bank outage; FAA ground stop.

**Assessment:** No new incidents; resolved reports indicate prior events contained. Quiet (high confidence).

## 5. UAP/UFO
Quiet in window. No official statements or releases.

**Assessment:** No movement (high confidence).

## 6. FRONTIER AND CONSCIOUSNESS RESEARCH
Quiet in window. No peer-reviewed or programme announcements in window.

**Assessment:** No movement (high confidence).

## FORECAST CHECK
1. NOT TRIGGERED — No confirmed additional Ukrainian strikes on Novorossiysk or further Kerch spans beyond reported damage.
2. TRIGGERED — Multiple tanker incidents near Hormuz confirmed in headlines and chatter.
3. OPEN — Iranian follow-on strikes occurred (Bahrain) but no major US asset hits or broad coalition response yet.
4. TRIGGERED — Russian missile remains found in Polish airspace per Kyiv Independent.

## INDICATORS AND WARNINGS
- Additional Ukrainian strike on Russian Black Sea Fleet asset or logistics node in 48h -> further Crimea isolation and Russian retaliation -> first on Russian MoD or Ukrainian General Staff statements -> likely.
- New tanker incident or UKMTO advisory in Hormuz in 48h -> supertanker rates spike -> first on Lloyd’s/UKMTO notices -> roughly even chance.
- Iranian or proxy strike on additional Gulf state or US asset in 48h -> broader coalition response -> first on IRGC or CENTCOM statements -> roughly even chance.
- Russian missile/drone spillover into NATO airspace with impact in 48h -> NATO air policing surge -> first on Polish MoD or NATO statements -> unlikely.

## COLLECTION GAPS
No independent confirmation of exact damage or casualties at Kerch Bridge or Benghazi beyond claims and imagery; casualty figures for Ukrainian strikes come primarily from one side; no primary-source detail on IRGC Bahrain targeting beyond official statements.

sections.Solar Activity: Past 24 h: Solar activity continued at very low levels with only B-level enhancements observed. Region 4579 (N15W36, Hsx/alpha) remained unchanged this period while Region 4581 (S08W01, Dro/beta) exhibited minor decay, especially amongst the trailing spots. An area of rudimentary spots were intermittently observed near S10W27, but this area remained unnumbered at the time of writing. No Earth-directed CMEs were identified in the available coronagraph imagery during the period.  Forecast: Solar activity is expected to be at very low levels, with a chance for C-class flares and a slight chance for M-class flares (R1-R2, Minor-Moderate) on 23-25 Nov.
sections.Energetic Particle: Past 24 h: The greater than 2 MeV electron flux remained at moderate levels. The greater than 10 MeV proton flux continued at background levels.  Forecast: The greater than 2 MeV electron flux is expected to be at normal to moderate levels on 23-25 Nov. The greater than 10 MeV proton flux is expected to continue at background levels on through 25 Nov.
sections.Solar Wind: Past 24 h: Solar wind parameters became weakly enhanced after ~22/0630 UTC, possibly associated with a SSBC. Total field increased to 8 nT and Bz saw a simultaneous southward deflection to -6 nT, and wind speeds increased to around 400 km/s.  Forecast: Slightly enhanced solar wind conditions are possible on 23 Nov due to the anticipated glancing influence from the 19 Nov CME. Ambient solar wind conditions are expected to prevail on 24-25 Nov.
sections.Geospace: Past 24 h: Geomagnetic field activity was at quiet levels throughout the period.  Forecast: The geomagnetic field is expected to be at quiet to active levels on 23 Nov due to possible glancing CME influences. Mostly quiet conditions are expected to prevail on 24-25 Nov.
